configuration.name: dd_median3_paired_anchor128
configuration.time_sampler_note: Each adjacent pair has one U[0,.1) anchor and one U[.1,1] context time from an antithetic draw, with random assignment to its samples. Marginal prefix probabilities: k=0 is .5; k=1..9 are 1/18 each.
configuration.train_notes: Official DD EMA initialization under dd-selfproto-v1.3. 128 targets, three proposals per original label, stable lower-median LPIPS-distance selection, one pass, uniform weights. Frozen training and evaluation settings are supplied exclusively by the trainer.
